title: Needs and wants picture sort
subject: PSHE
source: Seeded from pshe/y2 lesson 5 (Needs and wants picture sort (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 5: Why do we have money? Needs and wants. To understand the difference between things we need and things we want

blocks.title: Sort into: Need / Want
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Need, Want.
blocks.answer: Need: Bread; Water; Coat. Want: Toy car; Sweets; Game

questions.q: Show me: is a coat a need or a want?
questions.model: Teacher asks: could I live without it in winter? No, so it is a need.

questions.q: Show me: is a sticker book a need or a want?
Sort the pictures on your sheet into needs and wants (pupil PDF).
questions.a: Needs: food, water, coat, bed; wants: toys, sweets, games.
questions.model: Teacher sorts the first two cards.

questions.q: Draw one need and one want of your own.
questions.a: For example: a bed (need) and a ball (want).

questions.q: A want is... A) something we must have B) something nice to have C) money
Big question: bread or a toy car with £1? Why?
questions.a: Bread, because it is a need.
